description: REM Projects House activity history. Append-oriented: consequential events in order. Nothing is removed.

events.summary: Robert built the Projects House skeleton and put it live on GitHub Pages (repo HorizonTks/remprojects). Seven rooms: Foyer, Publishing, Library, Workshop, Study, Webworks, Archives, over an empty data layer.
Robert issued the revised inventory (TRP_Inventory.docx), superseding Muse's first walk of the skeleton and governing the population phase.

Public visibility resolved: the repo and Pages site stay public. House rule adopted: TRP tracks the work; it does not warehouse sensitive material. Manuscripts, correspondence, contracts, financials, and credentials stay in protected storage; TRP holds pointers and operational metadata only.
Works registry populated with the approved seven-work seed inventory.
Webworks registry populated with the eight known web properties.

Publishing ledger populated. CORRECTION OF RECORD: the ledger holds 26 records, not 25 as the commit message and first report stated. Muse's count was wrong; the committed content is exactly what Robert approved, record for record.

Robert added two works records directly on 2026-11-15: remembering-youre-extraordinary and remembering-youre-extraordinary-rye-2. Muse found them during the rendering-day check; Robert confirmed both are his and directed this backfill event so the history explains why the registry grew from the approved seven to nine.
Robert ruled there is only one book, Remembering You're Extraordinary, and RYE 2.0 is version 2 of that same book. The two works records were folded into one, its status carrying the version 2 note.

Each works record gained an explicit on_workbench mark. On the bench: Where Hearts Abide, Greystone Book I: Dorian, TSC Book I: Unraveling Darkness, The Inheritor, Joe Thoroughgood Adventures, Buttermilk Sandwitch, and Remembering You're Extraordinary through its version 2. Off the bench: The Story Standing in Front of the World, by Robert's correction replacing it with Where Hearts Abide.

Work-in-progress folder pointers recorded, house pointers only, no contents: Joe Thoroughgood Adventures and Buttermilk Sandwitch works records, and The Rye House Etsy Store webworks record, each now carries its OneDrive WIP folder path. The REM Projects webworks record status was refreshed to the rendered, wired house.

The Grynkie Treasury entered the works registry (id the-grynkie-treasury, Reported, last verified 2026-11-16) with its IngramSpark hardcover production plan: cover PDF in hand, 32 galley pages built and reviewed, print approval pending, and a 2026-11-18 production follow-up. It stands on the workbench as a print-production project, off the Santa's Workshop bench. Muse recorded the record and this event at Robert's direction in the main chat.

events.actor: Robert (correction, via Creative Writing Contests); Muse (recorded)
events.summary: At Robert's correction, the webworks records for the Remy Miller author site and The Rye House now name their remaining work in full, from the 2026-10-30 site audit and redesign brief, and from Robert's revisions with Charli, instead of naming only the decisions pending on them. The daily on-tap card practice was amended the same day: when a record carries named work, the card names the work.

Robert rebuilt the Remy Miller author site himself as a full build, the Christmas Literary Atelier, and put it live on GitHub Pages. The long-open scope question is answered by the build. Pointing of rremymiller.com awaits his word.

The intended domain rremymiller.com was registered (the 2026-11-06 purchase had registered the transposed spelling rrmeymiller.com), its DNS pointed at GitHub Pages, and HTTPS issued and enforced the same day. remyrmiller.com was set to Permanent 301 forwarding to https://rremymiller.com with its Zoho mail records verified untouched, and rrmeymiller.com was set to Permanent 301 forwarding to the same address as a typo catcher. Redirects were still propagating at the last check.
